concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-classic-platforms-account-holders-and-accounts]] — 2021-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Classic Account API v6 guide to sub-merchant account-holder creation, automatic and optional accounts, asynchronous notification gates, and separate payment-versus-payout verification.
warnings: Optional createAccount HTTP 202 paragraph says ACCOUNT_CREATED confirms account-holder creation (raw line 429), although the step creates an additional account for an existing holder (lines 407–411).
